WITH grp AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
         s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
         AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb,
         AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
mean_ref AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_avg_remaining
  FROM grp
)
SELECT g.site_code,
       g.insurance_status,
       g.avg_remaining_gb,
       g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
       g.avg_remaining_gb / NULLIF(m.mean_avg_remaining, 0) AS remaining_ratio
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN mean_ref m
WHERE m.mean_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
